messages:
Maria (Design): Hey team — quick microcopy + a11y check for the tenant/org switch UI. I mocked a tooltip and the empty state copy. Can you skim for clarity, tone, and keyboard/accessibility nits? Maria (Design): Current tooltip: `Switch organizations to view data for different accounts.` Empty state: `You don't have any organizations yet. Create one to get started.` Maria (Design): Problems I'm worried about: "organizations" vs "workspaces" term consistency, verb tense, long tooltip text on small screens, and whether the CTA is discoverable for keyboard users. Kevin (PM): +1 on term consistency. We use "organization" across billing and RBAC, but product screens sometimes say "workspace". Prefer standardize to "organization" here. Tone: make the tooltip slightly more actionable. Maybe mention "switch your active org" rather than just "view data". Sam (Frontend): I agree on shortening the tooltip. Tooltips can wrap awkwardly. Suggest: `Switch your active organization` (short) and a secondary helper text in the empty state. Also add `role="tooltip"` and ensure tooltip is announced on focus. Alex (Eng): For keyboard: ensure the tenant switch is a focusable button with an `aria-haspopup="listbox"` and `aria-expanded` toggled. Tooltip-only copy shouldn't be the only place that explains actions — replicate key hint in the menu header. Also avoid punctuation at end of tooltip (keeps VoiceOver shorter). Kevin (PM): For empty state copy, propose: `No organizations yet — create an organization to get started.` CTA button: `Create organization` (verb-first). Keeps microcopy consistent with other CTAs. Sam (Frontend): Small nit: contraction "Don't" vs "No" — contractions read oddly with some screen readers. Prefer `No organizations yet` as Kevin suggested. Maria (Design): New combined suggestion: Tooltip: `Switch active organization` (no trailing period). Empty state heading: `No organizations yet` Body: `Create an organization to get started.` Button: `Create organization` Maria (Design): Here's a quick snippet for the tooltip element we can hand to eng: ```html
Switch active organization
``` Alex (Eng): Looks good. Two follow-ups: 1) Ensure tooltip shows on keyboard focus as well as hover. 2) For narrow screens, we should prioritize the menu trigger label (e.g., show org name only) and hide the tooltip unless focus/press. a11y-bot: Automated check: Contrast check for our default tooltip background (#ffffff on #f2f2f2) fails (ratio 1.3:1). Recommend darkening text color to #111827 or use a darker background. Also recommended: add `role=tooltip` and ensure `aria-describedby` points to the tooltip id from the trigger for proper narration. Kevin (PM): Good catch — Maria, can you update the copy to include the ARIA note in the handoff? Also let's add a quick acceptance criteria: tooltip appears on hover and focus, announced by screen readers, and button has visible focus ring per design system. Maria (Design): Will do. Updated handoff copy bundle: Tooltip: `Switch active organization` (no punctuation). Empty state: Heading: `No organizations yet` Body: `Create an organization to get started.` CTA: `Create organization` Handoff notes: `Provide tooltip id and set trigger aria-describedby=. Tooltip must be keyboard-visible and meet WCAG contrast >= 4.5:1.` Sam (Frontend): Thanks — I'll pad the CSS focus state and add the aria-describedby. Alex (Eng): I'll add the a11y acceptance to the ticket. Marking this as ready for dev once Sam validates contrast in the component. :thumbsup: Maria (Design): Thanks everyone! Going to update the PR and attach the a11y checklist. :sparkles:
